Noah K: Quick sync note: prioritization workshop tomorrow for multi-region routing and tenant shielding. Need pre-reads.
Rina P: Pre-read bulletpoints: - Business asks: SLAs, residency control, cost transparency - Engineering constraints: batching/kv cache, throughput isolation - UX: simple lane creation + migration path - GA gates: pilots, stability, cost regression checks
Jae H: Engineering note: model-aware routing matters. If we route to quantized variants for cost, we must attach evals and quality gates. Propose auto-eval harness per-candidate route.
Noah K: Can we add a simple decision tree in the pre-read: when to recommend dedicated vs soft-lane vs private?
Rina P: Draft decision tree: if customer revenue > X and needs <Y latency delta -> recommend dedicated. If residency required -> private. Else -> soft-lane. We'll refine numbers.
